notes.title: Dec.5 Update
notes.content:
Updates:
- Added an in-game menu of the achievement list
- Fixed the bug in level 4, the player now can reach the white ending more easily, and somebody shouldn't running at the same position
- fixed the bug of some menu won't fade out totally
- Rewrote the overall menu system...(Hope it wouldn't cause any more new bugs)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40614337/5223c32cae8c447246a48649c00ac6b63ac0d001.png[/img]
Talk:
Sorry for being late with the new update... I've been busy with many things.
I'm not very familiar with programming, so I have to look up many things and take lots of time to do a new function or revise an old one.
Hope the next time I can put some new story level(s) here...! (But I'm not sure when will it be available)
